text.feels_intro: How {name}'s burns feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: reddened, tight skin like a bad sunburn; the eyebrows are singed. A faint smell of singed hair hangs about {him}.
{name}'s face: blistering burns, weeping and shiny; the hair is scorched. {name} smells of scorched hair and burnt skin.
{name}'s face: charred, blackened skin split and raw; the burns are terrible. The sickly-sweet stench of charred flesh hangs about {him}.
body: {name}'s back: reddened, tight skin like a sunburn, the clothing scorched. {name}'s clothing gives off a faint scorched smell.
{name}'s back: blistered, weeping burns; the clothing is melted into the skin in places. The smell of burnt cloth and blistered skin clings to {him}.
{name}'s back: blackened, charred burns across the back, raw and cracked, with a smell of burnt flesh.
arm: {name}'s {part}: red, tight skin like a sunburn. A faint singed smell rises from the skin.
{name}'s {part}: blistered, weeping burns. It smells of scorched skin.
{name}'s {part}: charred, blackened skin split open; the limb is raw. It reeks of cooked, charred flesh.
leg: {name}'s {part}: red, tight skin like a sunburn. A faint singed smell rises from {his} clothing.
{name}'s {part}: blistered, weeping burns, the clothing scorched away. It smells of burnt cloth and scorched skin.
{name}'s {part}: charred, blackened skin, split and raw; the leg is badly burned. The stench of charred flesh rises from it.

head: {name}'s face stings and prickles like a sunburn. {name} is jumpy and wary of heat.
{name}'s face burns and the blisters throb. {name} is angry and afraid and keeps flinching away from flame.
{name}'s face is searing, screaming agony. {name} is panicked, half blind and barely coherent.
body: {name}'s back stings like a hard sunburn, and clothing chafes. {name} keeps shrugging away from fabric.
{name}'s back burns and the blisters tear when {he} moves. {name} is stiff and furious.
{name}'s back is white-hot agony. {name} cannot bear any touch and is shaking, close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings like a sunburn. {name} holds it away from clothing.
{name}'s {part} burns, and the blisters throb. {name} cradles it and cannot grip.
{name}'s {part} is searing agony. {name} cannot bear to move it or let anything touch it.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings like a sunburn. {name} walks stiffly, away from rubbing cloth.
{name}'s {part} burns and the blisters throb with each step. {name} limps and grimaces.
{name}'s {part} is searing agony. {name} cannot bear weight and needs support to move.

levels: , a sudden scorch of heat. The flame licks across {name}'s skin and {name} jerks away with a hiss of pain. A smell of singed hair rises.
over skin that is already scalded. The fire bites into the raw burn and {name} shrieks as the pain flares.
, and the flames eat into the burn. The pain is huge and nauseating, the smell of scorched flesh sharp, and {name} staggers.
, and it is too much. The fire engulfs {name}; {name} screams, {name}'s skin blackening, and {name}'s strength drains away. The stench of charred flesh fills the air.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

start_unhurt.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. With no wounds to mend, it simply washes over {obj}, warm and soothing.
start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {name} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.

head: the fire burns {name}'s face away; hair and skin flare and blacken, the eyes boil and burst in their sockets, and charred skull shows through the cracked flesh. The stench of burned hair and cooked flesh chokes the air as {name} falls with a last, smoke-strangled shriek.

the flames pour into {name}'s mouth and eyes; {name}'s lips shrivel back from blackened teeth and the hollow sockets weep a boiling fluid. {name} collapses, smoking, and the smell of roasting meat and burned fat hangs over the body.
body: the fire splits the skin of {name}'s back and belly; fat bubbles and drips, the flesh beneath cooks dark, and in places the ribs show black through the char. A thick, sweet stench of roasting meat and burned hair rolls off {name} as {name} falls writhing and screaming, then lies still and smoking.

the flames eat through {name}'s chest and back until the cooked organs show beneath the cracked, blackened skin, and the smell of burned fat and cooked gut is sickening. {name} dies curled up tight, a final scream turning into a dry, smoky rattle.
arm: {name}'s {part} is burned to nothing but a blackened stump, the hand gone and the charred bone poking from a crust of cooked flesh. {name} falls shrieking, rolling in the dirt, and the stench of burned meat and hair fills the air until {name} lies smoking and still.

the fire strips {name}'s {part} to the bone; the flesh hangs in cooked, blackened strips and the fingers are curled into charred claws. {name} collapses in the smoke and the reek of roasting flesh, {name}'s last scream thin and cracked.
leg: {name}'s {part} is charred to the bone, the skin burst and blackened, the fat running and spitting. {name} falls and cannot rise, still burning, the smell of cooked meat and burned leather thick on the air as {name}'s screams die away.

the flames burn {name}'s {part} down to a black, smoking stump; the flesh has cooked away from the shin and the foot is a twisted lump of char. {name} drops, writhing, and dies in a haze of smoke that stinks of burned hair and roasted flesh.

soil: As {name}'s body goes slack, the stink of {name}'s shit and piss mixes with the reek of burned flesh.
In death {name}'s bowels and bladder let go, and the stench of shit and piss joins the smoke.
